name: Street Cred Football
summary: "Street Cred Football" strips away the polish and ambition of professional football and takes the game back to the street, where the only rule is to hit the crate – the goal – more times than your opponent. You choose your five-player team from a pool of 24 characters, including familiar faces like Joe Blade, and place them freely on the pitch. You control the player nearest to the ball, with full control over passing and shooting. Dirty tackles are not only allowed – they're encouraged.
